newsitem.title: USA: Schwarz Pharma gets FDA approval for EDEX.
newsitem.headline: Schwarz Pharma gets FDA approval for EDEX.

text.p: Schwarz Pharma Inc said Monday it received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market its EDEX treatment for impotence in the United States.
The treatment will be available by prescription within the next two months, the company said.
Schwarz Pharma Inc is the U.S. affiliate of Schwarz Pharma AG, based in Monheim, Germany.
Schwarz Pharma said the treatment will be packaged in patient kits in four dosage strengths. The company said more than 20 million men suffer impotency.
Schwarz Pharma shares were unchanged at 135 on the Frankfurt exchange.
